data.title: Bußgeldbescheid – red light fine, €118.50
data.case_title: Red light fine (Bußgeldbescheid) from Zentrale Bußgeldstelle Beispielmark
data.summary: The Zentrale Bußgeldstelle Beispielmark (Brandenburg traffic fines office) issued a Bußgeldbescheid against Doreen Musterlitz for running a red traffic light on 15 July 2025 in Beispielsruh (Havel). The total amount demanded is €118.50 (€90 fine plus fees), plus 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for a red-light violation. It states a total of €118.50 (€90 fine, €25 administrative fee, €3.50 delivery costs) and 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister (driver point register). You may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, or in person at the Bußgeldstelle, if you disagree — the app shows the deadline for this based on the delivery date shown on the enclosed delivery certificate. If you do not object by the deadline shown, the notice becomes final and the amount becomes payable two weeks after that. If you want to contest the ticket, consider getting advice from a traffic lawyer (Verkehrsrechtsanwalt) before the deadline.

key_facts.quote: Der Verstoß wird mit 1 Punkt im Fahreignungsregister beim Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt eingetragen.
